test.result: 33 passed (exit code 0); Ruff and mypy passed for the changed allocator and net-alpha modules.

implemented: NetAlpha calibration is explicit and calibrated forecasts require a nonempty calibration identity.
The allocator blocks all BUY entry from an uncalibrated forecast even when its provisional net value is positive.
Configurable maximum forecast-cost-to-gross-benefit ratio can force NO_TRADE; each observation retains the ratio and cost estimate.
Zero or below-hurdle net forecasts do not authorize entry, including when the configured hurdle is zero.
blockers: Calibration identity is a contract field, not cryptographic proof that a forecaster was calibrated on an approved development set.
Cost-benefit ratio limits remain caller-configurable until frozen by the training-only threshold artifact.
The gate is not wired to every legacy strategy executor, and rejected observations are not yet durably journaled across the platform.
scope_note: Local allocator now fails closed on uncalibrated forecasts and exposes a cost-benefit gate; system-wide wiring and verified calibration are incomplete.
